===taki-config.yaml===
listen: ":9998"

llm:
  api_base: "http://your-llm:8012/v1"
  model: "local"
  max_tokens: 4096

collabora:
  url: "http://collabora:9980"

whisper:
  api_base: ""
  model: "whisper-large-v3"

embedding:
  api_base: ""
  model: "nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5"

pdf:
  dpi: 150
  max_pages: 20

fallback:
  min_chars: 200
  min_chars_per_page: 50

routing:
  vector: always
  bleve_rules:
    - match:
        mime: ["application/pdf", "application/msword", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-*"]
      features: [meta, entities, summary]
    - match:
        mime: ["application/vnd.ms-excel", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml*"]
      features: [meta]
    - match:
        mime: ["message/*"]
      features: [meta, entities]
    - match:
        mime: ["text/*"]
      features: []
    - match:
        space_type: ["project"]
        mime: ["*"]
      features: [meta, entities, summary]
===tika.yml===
services:
  tika:
    image: codeberg.org/kosmos-eu/open_taki:latest
    networks:
      opencloud-net:
    restart: always
    volumes:
      - ./taki-config.yaml:/etc/open_taki/config.yaml:ro
    ports:
      - "9998:9998"
    logging:
      driver: ${LOG_DRIVER:-local}

networks:
  opencloud-net:
